/admin/jobs.name: escalation-notifications
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Notify HR and the manager when a leave or advance request has waited longer than the escalation window.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: إشعار الموارد البشرية والمدير عندما ينتظر طلب إجازة أو سلفة أكثر من مدة التصعيد.

/admin/jobs.name: leave-return-detection
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Watch for people coming back from leave: open a return for each approved leave, flag the overdue, and raise the return form on the first punch back.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: متابعة العودة من الإجازة: فتح سجل عودة لكل إجازة معتمدة، وتمييز المتأخرين، وفتح نموذج العودة عند أول بصمة بعد الإجازة.

/admin/jobs.name: delegation-ending
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Remind the manager and the acting approver the day before a delegation ends.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: تذكير المدير والموافق بالإنابة قبل يوم من انتهاء التفويض.

/admin/jobs.name: email-dispatch
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Send queued notification emails through the tenant's SMTP server, with retries.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: إرسال رسائل الإشعارات المنتظرة عبر خادم البريد الخاص بالمنشأة مع إعادة المحاولة.

/admin/jobs.name: retention
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Delete aged email deliveries, job runs, read notifications and used reset tokens per the tenant's retention windows; the audit log only if a window is set.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: حذف سجلات البريد والمهام والإشعارات المقروءة ورموز إعادة التعيين المستهلكة وفق مدد الاحتفاظ؛ وسجل التدقيق فقط إن حُددت له مدة.

/admin/jobs.name: missing-attendance
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Ask employees to explain working days with no punch, once per day and once per day missed.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: مطالبة الموظفين بتوضيح أيام العمل التي لا يوجد بها تسجيل حضور، مرة واحدة يومياً ولمرة واحدة لكل يوم.

/admin/jobs.name: whatsapp-dispatch
/admin/jobs.descriptionEn: Send queued WhatsApp template messages through the tenant's WhatsApp Business account, with retries.
/admin/jobs.descriptionAr: إرسال رسائل واتساب المنتظرة عبر حساب واتساب للأعمال الخاص بالمنشأة مع إعادة المحاولة.

/admin/settings.description: Ask each employee once per working day that has no punch on it to say what happened
How long after a day it can still be explained, and how far back the daily sweep looks
Restate a weekend or public holiday inside approved leave as a day of leave
Minutes to wait for a device to confirm a delivered command before delivering it again
How many times a command is delivered before it is marked failed
Provider offered first when a device is added
Accept connections from this company's biometric devices and send them commands
An enrolment request not completed within this many hours expires
Keep the body of every data request a device sends (templates are always redacted)
A device that has not called in for this long is shown offline

Tell the people who manage devices when a terminal has been silent this long, once a day until it returns. 0 turns it off. Separate from the offline marker above, which is about the screen: this one interrupts a person, so it is measured in hours. Added after two terminals went unnoticed for eight days while queueing commands nobody could deliver
realtime: punches become attendance within seconds; scheduled: on the next scheduled sweep
Public HTTPS address devices call, e.g. https://biotime.example.com. Blank uses the server's Biometric:PublicBaseUrl
Days to keep request bodies. Raw punches themselves are never deleted
Remove employees from devices automatically once they are suspended, terminated, resigned or retired
Minutes before a failed delivery is attempted again
Keep biometric templates a device reports, encrypted. Off by default: the device holds them, and not keeping a copy is the privacy-preserving choice
Days to keep audit log rows. 0 keeps them forever (the default: discarding evidence is a decision, not a default)
Days to keep sent and failed email rows; queued rows are never deleted. 0 keeps forever
Days to keep background job runs; failed runs are kept twice as long. 0 keeps forever
Days to keep read notifications; unread ones are never deleted. 0 keeps forever
Days to keep used or expired password-reset tokens. 0 keeps forever
Arabic name printed under the signature line on issued letters
Name printed under the signature line on issued letters (set before production use)
Arabic title printed under the signature line on issued letters
Title printed under the signature line on issued letters
Print a verification code and QR on issued letters so a recipient can check them without an account
Address the QR points at, e.g. https://hr.example.com. Blank uses the portal address configured in App:PublicUrl
Arabic declaration printed above the employee signature line on a final-settlement receipt
Declaration printed above the employee signature line on a final-settlement receipt. Blank prints a plain acknowledgement of receipt
Days a request may wait on a manager before it is flagged as escalated to HR on the requester's timeline and the HR inbox. 0 turns escalation off (Demo - verify before production use)
Whether an employee may request a new advance while still repaying one. When allowed, the cap applies to total exposure (outstanding + new) (Demo - verify before production use)
Maximum number of months over which a salary advance may be repaid (Demo - verify before production use)
Maximum salary advance as a multiple of monthly salary (Demo - verify before production use)
Let an employee import add a job title the organisation does not have yet. Off: a position is still created automatically when the job title already exists, and an unrecognised title stops the row

Let the procurement system (Tender Platform) on this server read who holds each approval position, their leave and their acting managers. Answers only on the server itself and only to requests signed with the shared secret below

Which HR position holds each approval, as key=CODE pairs separated by semicolons: a position code from Organisation -> Positions, or job: and a job code. Keys are the procurement system's: procurement_manager, purchaser, cost_control, coo, cado, ceo. Example: ceo=POS-0001
Shared secret, at least 32 characters. Enter the same value as HRM_SHARED_SECRET in the procurement system's settings
Go-live date for leave (yyyy-MM-dd). Accrual for staff employed before it starts here, from their imported opening balance; empty means from each hire date
Whether the employee may change who bears the exit/re-entry cost
Pre-selected cost bearer: Employee, Company or PerCompanyPolicy (Demo - verify before production use)
Offer the exit/re-entry visa section on leave requests
Who is offered exit/re-entry: foreign (nationality differs from the company country), all, or none
What your old system called each leave type, one 'old name=CODE' per line, used when importing leave already taken. Example: اجازة غير مدفوعه=UNPAID
How often to chase an employee who has not completed the return-from-leave form. 0 turns it off
The line manager confirms a return from leave before HR settles the days
Offer the flight ticket section on leave requests
Comma-separated leave type codes that offer a flight ticket
Who is offered a flight ticket: foreign, all, or none
Comma-separated ticket classes offered to employees
Comma-separated notification kinds that must not be emailed (e.g. PayslipAvailable)
Send notifications by email as well as in the portal
Address notifications are sent from
Display name on outgoing email
Application (client) ID of the app registration
Client secret of the app registration
Microsoft 365 directory (tenant) ID of the app registration
How mail leaves: smtp (a mail server with a password) or graph (Microsoft 365 through Microsoft Graph, as an application)
SMTP server host name
SMTP password
SMTP port (587 for STARTTLS)
Use STARTTLS when connecting
SMTP login (blank for an unauthenticated relay)
Address HR and other desktop users sign in at, e.g. https://hr.example.internal. Employees are sent to the public portal. Empty: everyone gets the portal
The account's API ID, shown in the Kalaam customer portal under API and sent in the welcome e-mail. Stored encrypted: it is half of a credential pair and there is nothing to gain from displaying it

The API password sent in the welcome e-mail. It can be reset in the customer portal under API, which is also where the server's own IP should be added to the whitelist so that these credentials are useless from anywhere else

The API root, as Kalaam gave it in the welcome e-mail - NOT the customer portal address. Blank by design: the host is per-customer and their integration guide prints it only as the placeholder YOUR_API_URL, so there is nothing to default to and a guess fails like a network fault rather than a missing setting
Send notifications as text messages
Comma-separated notification kinds to send by SMS; blank sends all
Which service carries the messages. Only kalaam is implemented; the key exists so that a second provider can be added without a migration

No longer does anything, and is kept only so that an existing value is not silently dropped. The previous provider had a confidential-message flag; Kalaam's API has no counterpart, so a sign-in code travels like any other transactional message. Leave it off
The name or number the recipient sees. It must already be registered with the provider, who refuses anything else outright
System-user access token with whatsapp_business_messaging
Meta app secret, used to verify webhook signatures (optional but recommended)
WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID
Template language for employees with no preference: en or ar
Send notifications as WhatsApp messages
Comma-separated notification kinds to send by WhatsApp; blank sends all
Phone number ID from Meta → WhatsApp → API setup
Which service carries the messages: meta (WhatsApp Business Platform, direct) or twilio (business solution provider)
Prefix of the template names submitted to Meta
Twilio Account SID (starts with AC), used when the provider is twilio
Twilio auth token
Approved Twilio content template (HX...) with two variables. Blank sends a plain message, which WhatsApp allows only within 24 hours of the employee writing first
Arabic content template; blank uses the template above for both languages
Approved Twilio content template (HX...) for the sign-in code: {{1}} the code, {{2}} the minutes. Blank sends a plain message, which WhatsApp allows only within 24 hours of the employee writing first
Arabic sign-in code template; blank uses the template above for both languages
Twilio WhatsApp sender in international format, e.g. +14155238886 for the sandbox
Verify token you choose; enter the same value in the Meta webhook configuration

Accept WhatsApp webhook deliveries that carry no verifiable signature. Off, and it should stay off: without an app secret there is nothing to check, so anyone who knows the tenant id could post delivery receipts. Exists only so a tenant already running without a secret can keep receiving them, deliberately, while it obtains one
Employee number prefix
Company code prefix
Deduct a day's pay for each unexcused absence (attendance status Absent) in the period's attendance window
Charge absence and unpaid leave against the full monthly entitlement (gross) rather than the basic salary alone

Which wage the end-of-service amount is calculated on. Basic salary alone; the total package (basic plus every fixed allowance); or basic plus only the allowances HR has reviewed and marked as counting. Set to basic, which is what the system did before this setting existed - confirm the correct basis with your legal advisor before changing it, because it moves what employees are paid on leaving
GOSI contributory wage is basic salary plus housing allowance
Highest monthly wage GOSI contributions are calculated on (verify against the current GOSI regulation)
Which salary the overtime hour is costed on: package (basic plus recurring allowances) or basic
What one overtime hour is worth before the premium, as a multiple of the hourly rate

/admin/settings.description: Job-title words that make an employee a labourer (paid overtime) when their Worker type is Automatic. Comma-separated; case, spaces and hyphens are ignored
Which salary the overtime premium is costed on: package or basic
The premium added on top of the hour, as a multiple of the hourly rate
Overtime pay multiplier applied to the derived hourly rate. Used only when the premium below is unset
Derive the daily and hourly rate from the calendar month (August 31 days, February 28) instead of a fixed 30-day month. Off keeps the Saudi norm, where a day is worth the same in every month

Which wage unused leave is paid out on in a final settlement. Set to the total package, which is what this customer asked for; change it only with the contract and your legal advisor in front of you, because it changes what a leaver is paid

How a settlement whose reason is 'mutual termination agreement' is treated when the end-of-service amount is worked out. Defaults to employer termination, which pays the full entitlement. This is a legal position rather than a fact, so it is a setting and HR can also override it on an individual settlement - confirm the right answer with your legal advisor
Standard working days per month, used to derive the daily rate for unpaid-leave deductions
Standard working hours per month, used to derive the hourly rate for overtime
Default date format
First day of week (0=Sunday)
Country code assumed for a mobile number saved without one (05xxxxxxxx), digits only. Used to reach the phone for the WhatsApp sign-in code
The company's time zone, as an IANA name such as Asia/Riyadh. Decides which calendar day an instant belongs to and what every time on screen reads
Weekend days
After the password, email the user a one-time sign-in code. Applies once outgoing email is configured and only to accounts with an email address

The password an employee uses the first time they sign in to the portal with their mobile number, before choosing their own. Everyone shares it until they change it, which they are forced to do immediately. Empty means employees sign in by WhatsApp code only

Let any active employee sign in to the self-service portal with their mobile number alone: a one-time code is sent to the phone over WhatsApp and the account is created on first use. Needs the WhatsApp channel configured

Which way the sign-in code travels: auto, whatsapp or sms. Auto prefers WhatsApp when it looks configured - but configured and working are different states and only a person can tell them apart, because WhatsApp can hold a valid token and phone number id while the template it needs is unapproved, and then every code fails at the provider. Set sms to say so

After the password is accepted on the self-service portal, send a one-time code to the mobile number on the employee's record and require it. Off by default: switching it on refuses every portal employee whose record carries no mobile number, so count them first

Require a sign-in code for anyone who can reach other people's data. Refuses the sign-in rather than falling back to the password alone. Turn on only once every administrator can receive a code - it locks out those who cannot
Minimum password length

defaultCapabilities.detail: The device uploads each punch as it happens (ATTLOG over PUSH), and resends what the server did not acknowledge.
DATA UPDATE USERINFO: user ID, name, privilege and card number.
DATA DELETE USERINFO: removes the user from the device together with what was enrolled on it.
DATA QUERY USERINFO: the device uploads its user list, which the HRM compares with its assignments.
INFO: the device reports firmware, counts and capacities.
CHECK: the device confirms it is receiving commands.
GET OPTION FROM: DeviceName, FWVersion, IPAddress, MACAddress, UserCount, FaceCount, AttLogCount and capacities.

DATA QUERY ATTLOG with a time range. The command is recognised on ZAM180 firmware; the range form has not been observed. Missed punches are normally recovered without it: the device keeps resending until the server acknowledges them.
Not offered. The HRM never deletes attendance from a device: the device copy is the last safeguard if the server is unreachable.
REBOOT is described in the PUSH protocol but has not been observed on this firmware. The device's answer will settle it.

No clock command is confirmed for this firmware. The HRM tells the device its time zone in every handshake reply (honoured by some firmware); set the device clock to automatic network time (NTP) on the device itself.
Enrollment must be completed on the physical device: Menu → User Management → the user → Face (or Palm). The HRM pushes the user first so they appear on the device with the right ID and name.
Enrollment must be completed on the physical device: Menu → User Management → the user → Face (or Palm). The HRM pushes the user first so they appear on the device with the right ID and name.
Whether this unit has a fingerprint sensor is not known from its model name - it is an option on this family. The device's own fingerprint count settles it on the next information upload (Sync info).

DATA UPDATE FINGERTMP writes a fingerprint to the device, which is what lets a person enrol at one terminal and be recognised at another. PROVEN on ZAM180-NF50VA-Ver3.4.9 on 2026-10-26, and not on the strength of the Return=0 the device gave - that was the evidence a GET OPTION FROM acknowledgement had already shown to be worthless. What proved it was the target's own fingerprint table growing: 33 records and 47,324 bytes on every dump from 2026-09-19 through 10:50 that day, then 34 records and 48,200 bytes immediately after the write. The 876-byte increase is one FP line carrying an 822-character template. The source terminal, which was never written to, stayed at 36 records and 51,602 bytes across the same window, so nothing else was synchronising the pair. The arriving template's SHA-256 matched the source byte for byte. DATA UPDATE BIODATA, for faces and palms, uses the same verb and mirrors the same inbound layout but has NOT been tested - do not read the fingerprint result as covering it.

DATA QUERY tablename=templatev10 (or facev7, fvtemplate) asks the device to upload a whole template table. Read out of the vendor's own server rather than observed, so unconfirmed until a device answers. ZAM180 firmware refuses it with -1004; other models may not.

Devices may upload templates (FACE, FP, BIODATA) after enrollment. When they do, the HRM records that the person is enrolled; the template itself is kept only if the company has switched on template storage, and then encrypted.

Not offered by this integration. The hardware can do it - a fingerprint template has been copied between two of these terminals and verified byte-identical - but the HRM does not send the command, and face templates additionally depend on matching algorithm versions. Enrol the person on each device, or use ZKTeco's own software for template distribution.
This device is dialled by the server over the SDK; it does not push. Attendance is read with 'Pull attendance' or by the pull worker on its schedule.
The server reads the device attendance log over TCP 4370 and files each punch. Punches already received are never duplicated.
Not offered. The device copy of the log is the last safeguard if the server is unreachable, so the HRM never clears it.
The server writes the user (ID, name, privilege, card) to the device over the SDK.
The server removes the user from the device, together with what was enrolled on it.
The server reads the device user list and marks each assignment present or missing.
The server reads serial number, firmware, platform and fingerprint-algorithm version on connect.
A connection test opens an SDK session and confirms the comm key is accepted.
The server sets the device clock over the SDK.
A restart command exists in the SDK but has not been exercised against these terminals from this build.

Enrollment is completed at the terminal: Menu → User Management → the user → Face (or Palm). The server pushes the user first so they appear with the right ID and name, then reads the enrolment back on the next sync.

/import/templates.label: Employees

columns.name: EmployeeId
columns.description: The employee number. Required. An existing one updates that employee; a new one creates them

columns.name: DateOfBirth
columns.description: Date, day first: 31/01/1995 (or 1995-01-31, or a Hijri date with H)

columns.name: Nationality
columns.description: From the Nationality list: name in either language or ISO code

columns.name: IdType
columns.description: National ID, Iqama or Passport (هوية مواطن / إقامة / جواز سفر). Says which number IdNumber is

columns.name: IdNumber
columns.description: The number of the document named in IdType

columns.name: NationalId
columns.description: Saudi national ID, when not given through IdType/IdNumber

columns.name: BorderNumber
columns.description: Border number (رقم الحدود), for an arrival who has no Iqama yet

columns.name: IqamaNumber
columns.description: Iqama number, when not given through IdType/IdNumber

columns.name: IqamaProfession
columns.description: Profession printed on the Iqama (المهنة في الإقامة)

columns.name: Sponsor
columns.description: Sponsor, when not the employing company

columns.name: MobilePhone
columns.description: International format, e.g. +9665xxxxxxxx (needed for WhatsApp). Format the column as text in Excel

columns.name: EmergencyPhone
columns.description: One number to call in an emergency

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Update only: Active, Probation, Suspended, Terminated, Resigned, Retired (new employees start Active)

columns.name: CompanyCode
columns.description: Only needed when the tenant has more than one company. Code from Organization -> Companies

columns.name: Department
columns.description: Code or name (either language) from Organization -> Departments

columns.name: Project
columns.description: Code or name from Organization -> Projects

columns.name: Position
columns.description: Position code, or the job title (either language) of a position in that company

columns.name: EmploymentType
columns.description: FullTime, PartTime, Contract, Temporary or Intern

columns.name: PaymentType
columns.description: From the Payment type list: Bank, Cash or Cheque

columns.name: BankName
columns.description: From the Bank list. None or blank means no account

columns.name: SalaryPackage
columns.description: Total monthly package, for checking only: it must equal Basic plus the allowances

columns.name: Basic
columns.description: Basic monthly salary - what payroll pays as basic

columns.name: ContractYears
columns.description: Length of the contract in years, e.g. 2 or 1.5. Fills in ContractEndDate

columns.name: ContractEndDate
columns.description: Date, day first. Worked out from ContractYears when that is given

columns.name: AnnualLeaveDays
columns.description: Annual leave entitlement in days agreed for this employee (VacationTayp)

columns.name: Labourer
columns.description: Worker type for overtime: Yes = labourer (paid overtime), No = staff, Auto = by job title. Blank = Auto for new employees and keeps what is recorded on updates

columns.name: EffectiveFrom
columns.description: Start of the assignment in this row (defaults to HireDate for new employees, today for changes)

/import/templates.notes: EmployeeId is the only column that must be filled; every other column may be left blank and completed later. It is kept exactly as the sheet gives it. An existing ID updates that employee, so the same sheet can be uploaded twice safely. An employee imported without a company is held without an assignment until one is given. Headers from the standard employee sheet (including the Arabic ones) are accepted as they are; list values may be in English, Arabic or code. Basic is the basic salary; allowances become pay components. Dates are day first (31/01/2026). Changing company, department, position, project, salary or contract dates starts a new assignment from EffectiveFrom and keeps the old one in history.

/import/templates.label: Jobs

columns.name: JobFamilyCode
columns.description: Job family, if you use them

columns.name: JobFunctionCode
columns.description: Job function, if you use them

columns.name: JobGradeCode
columns.description: Job grade, if you use them

/import/templates.notes: The job title. A position is this job as it exists in one department, and is loaded after.

/import/templates.label: Leave opening balances

columns.name: AsOfDate
columns.description: The day the balance was counted - normally the go-live date

columns.name: Days
columns.description: Days available on that day; decimals allowed, negative if leave was taken in advance

columns.name: LeaveType
columns.description: Leave type code; leave blank when there is only one leave type that accrues daily

columns.name: Notes
columns.description: Free text kept on the balance

/import/templates.notes: Each employee's leave balance on the go-live date, from your old records. Leave then accrues daily from that date at the employee's own package (21 or 30 days a year). Uploading a corrected sheet again replaces the opening figures without double-counting leave already taken.

/import/templates.label: Leave taken (from your old records)

columns.name: FromDate
columns.description: First day of the leave, day first

columns.name: LeaveDays
columns.description: Length in days, counting both the first and the last day

columns.name: ToDate
columns.description: Last day, day first. Leave it blank - or write the words your old system used for somebody who has not come back - and it is worked out from LeaveDays

columns.name: LeaveType
columns.description: Leave type code, or its name in English or Arabic. Blank uses the tenant's default annual type

columns.name: Reference
columns.description: The reference this leave had in the old system

columns.name: Reason
columns.description: Free text kept on the request

/import/templates.notes: Leave that was already approved and taken, loaded from the system you used before. Rows are matched on Reference, so correcting the sheet and uploading it again updates the same leave rather than adding a second one. Where the end date is missing - 'still on leave' - the end is worked out from the day count and the leave is marked as awaiting an actual return, which the terminals confirm later.

columns.name: AccruesDaily
columns.description: Yes to earn it day by day at each employee's own package (annual leave); default No

/import/templates.label: Positions

columns.name: JobCode
columns.description: The job this position is a seat of, by code or by title

columns.name: CompanyCode
columns.description: Only needed when the tenant has more than one company

columns.name: DepartmentCode
columns.description: Department the seat sits in, by code or by name

columns.name: EffectiveFrom
columns.description: Date the record starts, day first. Today when blank

/import/templates.notes: Load jobs and departments first. Headcount defaults to 1, which is what a single seat means.
